findings: F1 [mandatory/concurrency]: concurrency=konkurens végrehajtás is identical to preferred concurrent execution=konkurens végrehajtás. Official Go distinguishes the concurrency design/composition concept from concurrent execution (goroutines). Source/UI concurrency module and concurrency/1-11 cover channels, select and sync as well as execution. Reassess a context-sound glossary distinction; avoid equating the module-wide concept with execution alone.

F2 [preferred/closure]: closure=függvénylezárás lacks support in the reviewed Hungarian technical usage and lexically suggests closing a function, whereas moretypes/25-26 explicitly teach an environment-capturing function value. University of Szeged material uses zárvány for the same lexical-capture concept. Reassess the preferred term with documented Hungarian programming usage; distinguish it from ordinary function termination.
